include-after-body:
  text: |
    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
      let jsBlocks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('pre'))
      jsBlocks
        .filter((elt) => !elt.classList.contains('plaintext')) 
        .forEach(
          (elt) => editor.setup(elt, {language:'webppl'})
        )
      }
    )
    </script>
